experiment.question: Does paid chemical observation support understandable and interesting player decisions?
experiment.hypothesis: Players use chemical evidence in their choice and rate clarity and interest above the preregistered product thresholds.
experiment.falsifier: Thresholds fail, choices are mostly guesses, or a technical defect prevents the decision.
experiment.model: ScriptedBackend and scripted event interpreter; no neural model
experiment.task: gate-v1: reach the gate, investigate if desired, choose a reagent or leave
experiment.compute_budget: local standard-library Python; 10 minutes per participant; no external service
experiment.analysis_plan: Show all assignments, condition counts, distributions and missing answers; separate layouts; no population superiority claim.
experiment.success_criterion: clarity >=4 in 9/12; interest >=4 in 8/12; scan used and chemistry named in >=4/6 chemical-mode sessions
